acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. AKN Design Group assists with material selection, prioritizing durable, low-maintenance, and aesthetically appealing finishes suitable for rental units. Our extensive experience helps guide choices that withstand regular use while enhancing the property's value and tenant appeal. We provide expert recommendations that balance long-term durability with design trends, ensuring your investment is both practical and attractive. This is a core part of our managed process.
